headline: EPS rebounds sequentially, still below last year
summary_short: Mitsui Fudosan reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥28.04, down 37.4% y/y from ¥44.81.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥28.04 fell 37.4% year-over-year from ¥44.81, though it rose 29.8% sequentially from ¥21.61 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
